purpose: Empirically test whether AlphaDojo historical CN daily OHLC revisions between two immutable vintages are compatible with the scale-invariant V2.8.0 feature engine.

old.selection_reason: Pre-existing 2026-09-09 frozen extractor manifest; selected before V2.8.1 factor results.

cn_symbol_map.role: Vendor-symbol mapping for data-quality audit only; not official membership authority.

comparison_scope.rows: kline_t=1D, market=cn, quote_type=EQUITY, dates <= old-vintage max bar date

price_stability_per_symbol_requires: no old key missing from current vintage
no newly inserted current key at or before old max date for that old-present symbol
all matched OHLC values finite and positive
one median multiplicative close scale explains OHLC with max relative residual <=0.001
population_gate_requires: matched-row share belonging to price-stable comparable symbols >=0.995

handling.unstable_old_present_symbols: Exclude from V2.8.1 price-factor screen for all dates; exclusion is data-quality-based and outcome-blind.
handling.current_only_symbols: Exclude from V2.8.1 Stage-1 screen because pre-old-vintage history has not been vintage-audited.
handling.amount_drift: Report separately; it does not block the nine promotion-eligible price factors.
handling.pass_effect: Allows current pinned snapshot to supply historical scale-invariant price features only through the old-vintage max signal date.
handling.fail_effect: Block Stage-1 factor screen; require a different historical source architecture.

no_claim: PASS is not proof of strict historical source availability/PIT. It is a vendor-revision stability test for retrospective development only.
